reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Alacart again
reauth_confirm.description: Alacart no longer accepts the sign-in for {account}. Sign in again to keep your shopping lists in Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This Alacart account is already linked to Home Assistant.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with another Alacart account. Sign in with the account you linked before.
abort.premium_required: The Alacart account has no premium. Linking it to Home Assistant needs premium.
abort.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach Alacart. Try again later.
abort.missing_configuration: The Alacart integration has no way to sign in. Restart Home Assistant and try again.

create_entry.default: Your Alacart shopping lists are now to-do lists in Home Assistant.

application_credentials.description: Enter the client id of the app you registered on Alacart's developer page. Most users do not need this. Without it, Home Assistant signs in with its own client id.

invalid_token.message: Alacart no longer accepts the sign-in. Sign in again under Settings, Devices & services.

insufficient_scope.message: You allowed Home Assistant to read your lists only. Sign in again and allow changes.

premium_required.message: The Alacart account has no premium, so Home Assistant cannot reach your shopping lists.

list_full.message: The shopping list is full. Remove some items and try again.

item_not_found.message: The item is no longer on the list.

request_failed.message: Alacart could not make the change: {error}

token_refresh_failed.message: Home Assistant could not renew the sign-in with Alacart. It tries again later.

update_failed.message: Home Assistant could not read your Alacart shopping lists: {error}

try_later.message: Alacart is busy. Try again in a minute.
